integrity: Completely self-contained Python 3 verifier enumerating canonical Euler tours and all local in/out matchings, and using independently implemented substring-reversal and center-expansion dynamic programs. The entire finite domain is checked, not sampled.
limitations: The theorem is a finite exhaustive 2048-cycle, 65536-root classification at order five only; no formula for larger orders and no priority certification. No compression-bit-rate claim. Implementation trust risk remains without independent audit.
scientific_claim: Full order-five binary de Bruijn rooted palindrome-length histogram 4:384,5:3554,6:18266,7:29118,8:12138,9:2030,10:46, and complete 14-cell distribution of best/worst palindrome-partition lengths over 2048 cyclic classes; all cycles depend strictly on the cut and exactly two have best cut length nine.
title: Complete rooted palindromic-length spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
